name: Tactile Paving
description: Tactile paving slabs, some studded with rows of blister domes and some ribbed with corduroy bars, each raised mark casting a small shadow.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --m: @p(@var(--td), @var(--td), @var(--tb)); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(3%); clip-path: inset(3%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 9%; background: @p(var(--color3)); opacity: .45; -webkit-mask: @var(--m); mask: @var(--m); transform: translate(2.5%, 3%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 9%; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--m); mask: @var(--m); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --td: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 62%, transparent 62%) 0 0 / 25% 25%; --tb: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 30%, #000 30% 70%, transparent 70%) 0 0 / 100% 25%; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
